## About Me

Hi! I'm a passionate Test Automation Engineer based in Wuhan, China. I specialize in building robust testing frameworks and tools that help teams deliver high-quality software faster. Focused on Playwright, Azure DevOps, and AI-powered testing.

## Featured Projects

### Agent Skills

**[html-artifact-builder](https://github.com/python012/html-artifact-builder)** — an agent skill that generates single-file, self-contained HTML with React + shadcn/ui. No server, nothing fetched from the network, just double-click to open.

[![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/python012/html-artifact-builder)](https://skills.sh/python012/html-artifact-builder) · [Live demo](https://python012.github.io/html-artifact-builder/samples/sample-doc-en.html) · [中文示例](https://python012.github.io/html-artifact-builder/samples/sample-doc.html) · [Install](https://github.com/python012/html-artifact-builder#install)

### Web Tools

**[hanzi-big](https://github.com/python012/hanzi-big)** ![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/python012/hanzi-big)

An offline Chinese character card for kids: type a character and it fills the screen in regular script, with pinyin on top; click it to replay the stroke order stroke by stroke. One HTML file, no server, no network, nothing leaves the machine.

在浏览器里便捷显示汉字的小工具，方便向孩子展示汉字、笔顺和拼音，满屏楷体显示，上方标注拼音，点一下就能按笔顺逐笔演示。单个 HTML 文件，无需联网。

[Download](https://github.com/python012/hanzi-big/releases) · [Source](https://github.com/python012/hanzi-big)
